name: DatabaseAction
description: The agent's answer at a step whose prompt asks for this schema.

parameters.description: Structured response for each interaction step.

action.description: QUERY to execute an exploratory SQL statement and see results, or ANSWER to submit your final answer to the question.
action.title: Action

content.description: If action is QUERY: a SQL statement to execute against the database. If action is ANSWER: the exact value that answers the question — a raw number (e.g. '50000', '3.14') or short text (e.g. 'Acme Corp'). Do NOT describe how to get the answer; provide the actual value.
content.title: Content
